displayPattern: Red LED #1: off; Green LED #2: slow flash
meaning: Pressure prove switch open, OR blocked inlet/exhaust vent, OR pressure switch closed before the combustion air inducer started.
causes: Pressure switch closed prior to inducer activation
diySteps: Check outdoor inlet/exhaust terminations for blockage
Technician: check pressure switch and venting
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician: if vents are clear and the code persists.
